blocks.label: What must you do when someone is ill?

data.heading: What must you do when someone is ill?
data.text: In the Netherlands, the Gatekeeper Improvement Act (Wet verbetering poortwachter) sets fixed steps and deadlines for employers during the two years an employee is ill. For each moment you see what the law requires from you and what we do for you.

rows.title: Sick report
rows.jij: Report your employee sick, preferably on the first day of illness.
rows.wij: We get in touch and open the file.

rows.title: Problem analysis
rows.jij: The company doctor (bedrijfsarts) draws up a problem analysis (probleemanalyse) by week 6 at the latest.
rows.wij: We schedule the consultation and share the advice with you.

rows.title: Action plan
rows.jij: Together with your employee you draw up an action plan (plan van aanpak).
rows.wij: We guide the plan and record the agreements.

rows.title: Evaluation
rows.jij: Discuss progress and adjust the plan where needed.
rows.wij: We schedule the evaluations and record them in the file.

rows.title: Sick report to UWV
rows.jij: Report the illness to UWV, the Dutch Employee Insurance Agency, by week 42 at the latest.
rows.wij: We alert you in time for the report.

rows.title: First-year evaluation
rows.jij: Evaluate the first year of illness (eerstejaarsevaluatie) and agree the plan for year two.
rows.wij: We prepare the evaluation together with you.

rows.title: WIA application
rows.jij: Your employee applies for WIA benefit (Work and Income according to Labour Capacity Act); you provide the reintegration report (re-integratieverslag).
rows.wij: We compile the report from the file.

rows.title: Continued salary payment
rows.jij: You continue to pay salary for up to 104 weeks, in line with the law and your collective agreement (cao).
rows.wij: We make sure the file is complete for UWV.

alert.title: Beware of the wage sanction
alert.text: If UWV decides too little was done about reintegration, it can impose a wage sanction (loonsanctie): up to one extra year of salary payments. That is why we keep track of every deadline.

Questions from
employers
data.text: Can't find your question? Call or email us.

items.question: Am I required to have an occupational health service?
items.answer: Yes. Under the Dutch Working Conditions Act (Arbowet) every employer must arrange expert support for sickness absence and healthy working, including at least a company doctor (bedrijfsarts). You record this in a basic contract (basiscontract).

items.question: What is in the basic contract?
items.answer: Among other things: open consultation hours with the company doctor, the right to a second opinion, a complaints procedure and the option for the company doctor to visit the workplace.

items.question: Can we switch from another occupational health service?
items.answer: Yes. We take over ongoing absence cases, so no deadline is missed.

items.question: How quickly is there contact after a sick report?
items.answer: Your case manager contacts your employee within one working day.
